results.note: Direct indexed YouTube result with tracklist/timestamps in description.
Verified indirectly via JazzWax complete-album YouTube embed; embed ID recovered from source.

problem: Available web search does not expose YouTube search results with sufficient recall for bulk catalog classification. A 40-album exact-query batch returned only one direct YouTube result, while a separate web page proved another album had a complete YouTube embed. Therefore treating absent search results as youtubeStatus=unresolved would create widespread false negatives.
nextAction: Use a true YouTube search mechanism (YouTube Data API, yt-dlp/search-capable local process, or equivalent) before resuming Stage 3. Do not mark the remaining candidates unresolved from web-search absence alone.
